name: Hakusan National Park
description: National park (1962) of Mt. Hakusan, one of Japan's three holy mountains, with its alpine flowers, the Murodo plateau and shrines of the Hakusan faith.
notes: Designated 1962 (49,900 ha). The Ichinose trailhead and the Murodo plateau are the climbing gates.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
